title: Delegate agent work input
description: Ask the daemon for a piece of agent work on a named model route (docs/model-routes.md, section 8): the request as text, the route by name, and optionally a protocol (a runbook the daemon can run), a workspace (a directory under a daemon context root, copied into the run's workspace), settings, a session and an idempotency key. A delegation is a run: the accepted outcome (delegated) creates the Run as SubmitRun does, with the request as its intake, at the daemon's default level, and the daemon writes the run's first event `runbook.submitted` (sequence 1) and its second, `runbook.delegated` (the route, the path and the protocol), before the runtime records any; cancel-run, the run views and the events work on it unchanged. With a protocol that runbook runs (path `named`); with the protocol `delegation-free`, or without one on a daemon that has no classifier route, the free run (path `free`): one agent node whose instruction is the request, on the delegation's route, in the run's workspace, writing `result.md`; its runbook is `delegation-free`, the handler fills `runbook_id` with it. Without a protocol on a daemon with a classifier route (`[route_policy] classifier`) the daemon takes the path when the run starts (docs/model-routes.md, section 9): `runbook_id` is `delegation` and RunDelegated holds no path; one call on the classifier route through the relay, with the request and the catalog of the daemon's runbooks, answers a runbook and a confidence, and at the daemon's `[delegation] classify_threshold` (0 to 1, default 0.8) or above, when that runbook takes every input the answer fills, it runs with the request as its intake (path `classified`); below it a second call writes a protocol whose every action is the daemon's agent node (`sdc-node delegation.free`), which the daemon checks with the loader of a runbook and runs (path `generated`). The run event `runbook.delegation-resolved` records the path, the protocol, the confidence, the classifier route and the digest of a generated protocol; the classifier's answer and the generated protocol are files of the run's work/ directory under `delegation/`. A call the route does not serve fails the run's start `route-unavailable: ...`, an answer that is not the JSON asked for (after two more calls that quote the validator's error) `classifier-answer: ...`, and a generated protocol the loader refuses `protocol-refused: <the loader's line>` (FailRunStart, outside this command). Every model call of the run goes to that route through the daemon's relay. The run's result is read by its id from the view DelegationResult. The handler mints the run id and fills `run_id`, `runbook_id`, `confinement`, `route`, `model_route_alias`, `model_route_source`, `daemon_id` and `at`, and reports five facts it reads from the host: `route_declared` (the route the delegation names, or the daemon's default route when it names none, is one the daemon declares), `runbook_known`, `context_inside_roots`, `repository_allowed` and the size of the request (checked here). Before anything is written the handler also asks the route's gateway what a submit asks (docs/model-routes.md, section 3: `GET /ready`, `GET /v1/models`, the status of the route's model): a gateway that is not ready or does not answer refuses the delegation with 503 `route-unavailable` naming the route, the daemon's `{refused, message}` answer, outside the language as a draining daemon's refusal is; an alias the gateway does not list refuses it `route-refused`; a model that cannot answer yet leaves the run waiting for its route (WaitForRoute) as a submitted run waits. A delegation whose path is still open (it names no protocol on a daemon with a classifier route) is read with the classifier route as well: no classify call goes to that route before it can answer. A delegation may name a `serial_key` as a submit does (SubmitRun): one queue per key holds submitted and delegated runs alike. A delegation may name a `repository` (story a-delegation-changes-a-repository-on-its-own-branch, first slice): an entry of the daemon's runbook.toml by its name, at the level local. Its path is `change` and its runbook `delegation-change`; the handler resolves the entry's base to a commit, and the run event `runbook.delegated` records the repository and that commit. When the run starts the daemon makes the run's worktree of the repository with the host's `worktree` command, and the run's one agent node works in it. When the run's outcome is delivered the daemon commits the change under the entry's identity on that commit and pushes it as the new branch runbook/<run-id> to the entry's remote, never forced, never with a path of the entry's deny_paths, never when the worktree's .git file changed; the run event `runbook.handed-back` (branch, commit) or `runbook.hand-back-refused` (reason) records it before the run ends, and the view DelegationResult names it. Right before the push, while the run is live, the run event `runbook.pushing` (branch, commit) is written: a cancel before it pushes nothing, and a cancel after it does not stop the push, whose branch the view then names. A run that ends any other way pushes nothing and keeps its worktree.

request.description: The work asked for, as text: the run's intake, at most 1 MiB.

model_route.description: The route the run's model calls take, by the name the daemon declares it under; absent: the daemon's default route, and a daemon with none refuses the delegation as route-refused. Never an address, a token or an alias.

protocol.description: The runbook to run with the request as its intake, or delegation-free for the free run; absent: the daemon classifies the request when it has a classifier route, else the free run.

workspace.description: A directory under one of the daemon's context roots: its files are copied into the run's workspace before the run starts, without .git and the exclude list, within the bounds (ContextPath).

workspace_exclude.description: Names or relative paths the copy of the workspace leaves out besides the daemon's exclude list, as a submit's (SubmitRun).

serial_key.description: The serial key of the run, as a submit's (SubmitRun).

caller.description: Who asked: the name the MCP client gave in initialize (clientInfo.name), at most 200 characters. `runbook mcp` fills it; it is no argument of the MCP tool. Recorded in the run event `runbook.delegated`.

caller_label.description: The label of the session that asked (RUNBOOK_CALLER of the session `runbook mcp` serves), at most 200 characters. `runbook mcp` fills it; it is no argument of the MCP tool. Recorded in the run event `runbook.delegated`.

repository.description: A repository the delegation changes, by the name of its entry in the daemon's runbook.toml (`[repositories.<name>]`), never a path: the run takes the path change and the protocol delegation-change (no other protocol may be named beside it), at the level local only.

runbook_id.description: The runbook the run takes: the protocol; delegation-free for the free run; delegation for a delegation the daemon classifies when its run starts. The handler fills it.

confinement.description: The daemon's default level: a delegation names none. The handler fills it; a daemon with no default refuses the delegation by name (400) and writes nothing.

route.description: The route the run takes, by name: model_route, else the daemon's default route. The handler fills it.

model_route_alias.description: The alias of route at its gateway, as the daemon's file declares it. The handler fills it.

model_route_source.description: run when the delegation named its route, default when it took route_policy.default. The handler fills it.

path.description: named when the delegation names a runbook, free for the free run; absent for a delegation the daemon classifies when its run starts. The handler fills it.

repository_allowed.description: The handler's fact: true when the delegation names no repository, or names an entry of the daemon's runbook.toml by its name, with no protocol other than delegation-change, at the level local, and the entry's base names a commit of its checkout.

sdc.daemon.ConfinementLevel.title: ConfinementLevel
sdc.daemon.ConfinementLevel.description: How strongly a run is sandboxed, weakest first: the runtime's names. local is not confined; linux is. oci and pod are the runtime's planned levels and are not in the set until it offers them. A submit that names no level runs at the daemon's default level (runbook serve --default-confinement, or `confinement` of runbook.toml); a daemon with none refuses the submit by name and writes nothing, as the binary has no built-in default; the handler fills it. The daemon's floor is linux unless it is started lower; the default is never below the floor, and a daemon whose default is below its floor does not start. local must be asked for by name or set as the default, and is refused under a linux floor.

sdc.daemon.ContextPath.title: ContextPath
sdc.daemon.ContextPath.description: A directory on the daemon's host, given as an absolute path. The daemon accepts it only when it lies under one of its context roots (runbook serve --context-root <dir>, repeatable; none given means no context from a path), and copies it into the run's workspace before the run starts: directories and regular files only, never an entry named .git (a directory, or the file of a linked worktree), never an entry of the exclude list (the daemon's `[delegation] copy_exclude`, default target/ and node_modules/, and the run's own workspace_exclude), within `[delegation] copy_max_entries` entries (default 50000) and `copy_max_bytes` bytes (default 268435456). A context over a bound fails the run's start `context-over-bound: ...` naming the bound, and nothing of it is copied (FailRunStart, outside the language); a copy writes the run event `runbook.context-copied` (record: exclude, the list it applied; entries and bytes, what it copied; skipped, the count of entries it left out).

sdc.daemon.DaemonId.title: DaemonId
sdc.daemon.DaemonId.description: The id of the one daemon the specification describes: the configuration row it holds is keyed by it. The HTTP handler fills it; one process is one daemon.

sdc.daemon.DelegationPath.title: DelegationPath
sdc.daemon.DelegationPath.description: How a delegation became a run (docs/model-routes.md, section 9): named (it named a protocol, and that runbook runs with the request as its intake), free (the free run, one agent node whose instruction is the request, writing result.md: asked for by the protocol delegation-free, or taken by a delegation that names no protocol on a daemon without a classifier route), classified (it named none, and one call on the classifier route picked a runbook of the daemon at or above the threshold of confidence, 0.8) or generated (the classifier's confidence was below it, and one call on the classifier route wrote a protocol of the daemon's parts, which the loader accepted) or change (it named a repository of the daemon's runbook.toml, `[repositories.<name>]`: the protocol delegation-change, one agent node working in the run's worktree of that repository, whose change the daemon commits and pushes as the branch runbook/<run-id> when the run delivers).

sdc.daemon.ExcludeEntry.title: ExcludeEntry
sdc.daemon.ExcludeEntry.description: An entry of the exclude list of a context copy: a name matched at any depth (target/, fixtures) or a relative path from the context root (docs/big/); one that ends in / matches a directory only, one without it a directory or a file, and a name matches a whole name only. An absolute path, an empty, . or .. part, a NUL, more than 200 characters or more than 64 entries are refused before anything is written (400), naming the member and the entry's place, never its value.

sdc.daemon.IdempotencyKey.title: IdempotencyKey
sdc.daemon.IdempotencyKey.description: Optional text, at most 200 characters, unique per daemon, that a client sends to retry a submit safely: a second submit with a key already used returns the first run and creates none.

sdc.daemon.RouteName.title: RouteName
sdc.daemon.RouteName.description: The name of a model route the daemon declares (a table [routes.<name>] of its runbook.toml): one to 64 characters of letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`. A client names a route by it, never by an address, a token or an alias; the address, the token file and the prices stay in the daemon's file.

sdc.daemon.RouteSource.title: RouteSource
sdc.daemon.RouteSource.description: The setting that chose a run's route: run (the submit named it, `model_route` or `model_routes.<role>`), protocol (the runbook's route entries, the file `bindings/<runbook>.routes.yaml` of format runbook.routes/1: the route its entry for the role names, or the route that meets the entry's needs; docs/model-routes.md section 2) or default (the submit named none and the daemon's `route_policy.default` applied; a daemon whose file declares no route but a lone `[gateway]` table and a model decider declares the interim route `default` on that gateway and takes it as its default, so a model run that names none says default too). The run's word comes first, then the protocol's, then the default.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.

sdc.daemon.RunSettings.title: RunSettings
sdc.daemon.RunSettings.description: The settings of a run: a map from text to text (runbook run --set key=value), kept as written. Typed members come with the runtime's run-settings story; none are declared now.

sdc.daemon.RunbookId.title: RunbookId
sdc.daemon.RunbookId.description: The name of a runbook: a preset (sdc, sdc-bugfix) or the name of a runbook in the daemon's --runbook-dir.

sdc.daemon.SerialKey.title: SerialKey
sdc.daemon.SerialKey.description: Optional text, 1 to 200 characters, that the submitter names (the daemon never derives one): runs with one key run one at a time, in the order they were submitted. A run whose key a run submitted before it holds is WaitingOnKey until no such run holds it: a live run holds it, and a run that was taken up holds it until its run thread in the daemon has returned, also after it was Cancelled; runs with another key or none are not held. A key that is empty or longer is refused before anything is written (400).

sdc.daemon.SessionId.title: SessionId
sdc.daemon.SessionId.description: The name of a session, chosen by the client that opens it.
